BiblicalUsage: Tsair — Zair — was a place in Edom where King Joram went out to meet the Edomites who had revolted. He went by night, and though the Edomites surrounded him, he broke through and escaped to his own country. The town is named once, as the scene of a king's narrow escape.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Bible names the ground where kings were humbled, and Zair is one of them. Joram's escape was God's mercy, not his strength.
